description: Leaking bathtub supply pipe, discovered end of July after a few days of seeping. The whole bathroom floor (about 6 m² of tiling) was wet and had to be taken out and relaid. Water reached the living room through the shared wall: about 18 m² of laminate had to be removed and reinstalled together with the skirting, and the lower part of the living-room wall along the partition had to be prepared and repainted. Ceiling and hallway were both checked and were dry — nothing done there. Pipe repaired promptly; drying ran a few days before the trades started.

lines.1: Remove water-damaged laminate in living room 18 m²
lines.2: Supply & install premium oak laminate incl. impact sound insulation, living room | 18 m²
lines.3: Supply and install skirting boards (premium solid oak, upgrade) | 25 linear m
lines.4: Disassembly and disposal of damaged floor tiles in bathroom | 6 m²
lines.5: Supply & install premium large-format Italian porcelain tiles in bathroom incl. material | 6 m²
lines.6: Cleaning of entire apartment 1 flat rate
lines.7: Paint lower wall after water damage incl. surface preparation | 20 m²
lines.8: Full ceiling paint living room 15 m²
